lines.text: Many learners say: The file follows attached.
In English, the file is attached.
The first! My résumé is attached.

data.why: In English, the file is attached.

native.tip: Em e-mails, em vez de “segue anexo”, escreva “is attached”: “The file is attached.”
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente escreve “The file follows attached.” O certo é “The file is attached.” Em português escrevemos “segue anexo”, mas em inglês o certo é “is attached”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.

en.tip: In emails, instead of “segue anexo”, write “is attached”: “The file is attached.”
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people write “The file follows attached.” The right way is “The file is attached.” In Portuguese we write “segue anexo”, but in English the right way is “is attached”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
